capabilities: Show indicators for links, block references and embeds
Reveal associations between files across the vault
Resurface hidden connections without opening search or backlinks
extras: Documentation and how-to videos live outside the README. The README states the plugin is looking for new maintainers.
intentEvidence: The problem is you have to search, open backlinks, and so on to find out what is going on.
motivation: To resurface networked-thought connections in a way that is not too intrusive while reading and writing notes.
problem: Obsidian hides cross-note associations behind search and the backlinks pane, so you have to actively look to find out which files reference the current one.
summary: Displays indicators for links, block references and embeds so you can see how notes connect without running searches or opening backlinks.
